title: Tailoring ultra-small ZnO nanoparticles through cobalt doping to enhance photocatalytic CO2 reduction
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,11934-11941
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01374G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Wen-zhu Yang, Imran Ullah, Zhan-Guo Jiang, Reinhard B. Neder, Cai-Hong Zhan
The photocatalytic reduction of CO2 using cobalt-doped zinc oxide nanoparticles (Co-ZnO NPs) achieves a CO yield of 143.90 μmol g−1 h−1, which is 15.73 times higher than that of undoped ZnO, and exhibits excellent stability.
